title: New Tick Plot mark type (strip/rug plot: short ticks along one axis per data point)

complexity.rationale: Confirmed no tick-plot mark exists anywhere in the codebase: an exhaustive grep for tickPlot/tick-plot/TickMark/tickMark across packages/vega-spec-builder/src and packages/react-spectrum-charts/src returned zero matches (deliberately distinguished from Axis's unrelated 'ticks' rendering). This is a wholly new mark type, not an extension — it needs its own types file, spec builder (data/signals/scales/marks), React component, adapter case, and story, following the same multi-file shape as every existing mark (e.g. Scatter: scatterSpecBuilder.ts, scatterMarkUtils.ts, scatter.types.ts, Scatter.tsx, childrenAdapter.ts:213) but with none of the position/encoding logic reusable as-is, since no minimal prop API was given in the source issue and one must be designed from scratch. New mark type + no precedented API + significant open design work => 5.

summary: Request for a new 'Tick Plot' mark type — short vertical (or horizontal) tick marks placed along a shared scale, one per data point or category, in the style of a strip/rug plot, often used to show individual data points or distribution density along a single axis. No detailed prop API was given in the source issue, so a minimal reasonable API is proposed here based on conventional tick-plot/strip-plot semantics.
requirements: Define a new TickOptions type (dimension: string for the position field, optionally a color/group facet, tick length/width/opacity styling) analogous in shape to existing mark *Options types (e.g. packages/vega-spec-builder/src/types/marks/scatterSpec.types.ts).

Support a single categorical or continuous dimension field positioning each tick along one axis (matching the 'along a shared scale' behavior shown in the issue's screenshot), with the other axis unused/collapsed (a 1-D strip), or optionally faceted into rows/lanes by a grouping field for multi-series tick plots.
Support an optional color facet so ticks can be colored by series/category, consistent with how Line/Bar/Scatter use ColorFacet.
Support configurable tick length and width (visual styling), analogous to LineWidth/LineType conventions used elsewhere.

Register the new mark type end-to-end: a new markType value ('tick' or similar) in the chartType/markType enums, a spec builder module (addTick pattern mirroring addScatter in chartSpecBuilder.ts:52,166-168), a React <Tick> component, and a childrenAdapter.ts case (mirroring Scatter.displayName at childrenAdapter.ts:213).

Support basic hover/tooltip interactivity consistent with other marks (isInteractive, voronoi-style hit-testing appropriate for thin tick marks, which may need a wider invisible hit-target than the visible tick).

edgeCases.case: Many overlapping data points at the same or very close position values
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Ticks should remain individually distinguishable or clearly convey density (e.g. via opacity/jitter) rather than fully overlapping into a solid block.
Renders one tick at the correct position; no special-casing needed if scale domain handles a single value gracefully.
Renders an empty plot area with axes, consistent with how other marks handle empty data.

edgeCases.case: Long category labels on the shared axis
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Standard axis label truncation/rotation behavior should apply, same as any other categorical axis.
Tick color/opacity must resolve via the same BACKGROUND_COLOR-aware and colorScheme-aware helpers used by other marks (getColorProductionRule, etc.), not hardcoded values.
As a brand-new mark, it does not exist in either package yet; S2 support is a deliberate follow-up, not part of this initial spec (see crossCutting.requiresS1S2Parity).

crossCutting.notes: touchesLegendInteraction: if a color facet is supported, the new mark's ticks should participate in legend hover/click highlighting the same way every other faceted mark does. touchesTooltipOrPopover: basic hover tooltip support is listed as a requirement, and thin tick marks likely need a widened invisible hit-target, which is new (non-precedented) hit-testing logic. requiresNewSignalOrScale: as a new mark with its own position/color facets, it will need its own hover/tooltip signals and will add to the shared color/opacity scale domains the same way other marks do. requiresS1S2Parity: this is a genuinely new mark that doesn't exist in either s1 or s2 today; scoping the initial implementation to s1 only (per this spec's variant) means s2 needs the same mark built as a deliberate, tracked follow-up rather than an afterthought.

implementationPlan.change: New file. Define TickOptions (public contract) and TickSpecOptions (defaults-applied + internal fields), following the LineOptions/LineSpecOptions pattern described in this repo's CLAUDE.md.
New file. addTick() produce-wrapped function: addData/addSignals/setScales/addTickMarks, mirroring addScatter's structure in scatterSpecBuilder.ts.
New file. Builds the actual Vega 'rule' or 'rect' mark encode for each tick (position, length, width, color, opacity, hover hit-target).
Register a new markType case ('tick'), a tickCount accumulator, and call addTick — mirroring the existing scatter registration.
New file. TickProps extending TickOptions via Omit, per the mark type pattern.
New file. Render-null component holding prop defaults, following Scatter.tsx's pattern.
Add a `case Tick.displayName:` alongside the existing Scatter.displayName case.
New file. Baseline Tick story plus a color-faceted variant, following the storybook pattern described in this repo's CLAUDE.md.
The chartType enum has no 'tick'/'tickPlot' value; a real implementation PR would need to add one (this spec cannot add it unilaterally — see openQuestions).

openQuestions: The source issue included only a screenshot, no explicit prop API — the requirements above (dimension, optional color facet, tick length/width) are a reasonable minimal default based on conventional strip/rug plots, but should be validated against the actual attached screenshot and the legacy 'UDD' dashboard system's tick plot before implementation.

planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum (area/bar/bigNumber/bullet/combo/donut/line/scatter/venn/chart) has no value for this new mark; a real implementation PR would need to add one (e.g. 'tick' or 'tickPlot'). This spec uses 'chart' as the closest existing fit in the meantime.
Should ticks support faceting into multiple lanes/rows (one row per series/category) out of the gate, or should that be a fast-follow once the single-lane case ships?
Should this mark be oriented vertically or horizontally by default, or configurable via the same 'orientation' convention Bar uses?
